services.name: 2 Hour Sail
services.desc: We offer private sailing instruction at times that works for you. Private lessons are great for families looking to spend quality time together and busy professionals needing specific instruction. Lessons may be used to further skill levels or to just get some extra time on the water. You will leave the lesson with practical, basic skills that enable you to operate with control and confidence on the water. We can accommodate all levels of sailor from beginner to advanced. Is there something special you want to work on? Docking maneuvers, night sailing, or sail trim? Just let us know and we will be sure to accommodate your

includes: Licensed captain and crew on charters
Dishes, utensils, and ice provided on charters
All cups, plates, glasses, utensils, and ice provided
ASA materials and certification included in some courses
gap: Age minimum for private charters not stated
blurb: Guests can book private sailboat charters on a 38' modern sailboat with a licensed captain and crew. Sailing lessons range from beginner to advanced levels, including American Sailing Association certification courses. The company also runs New York City's first Summer Sailing Programs for kids.
